hero.title: Automate the management of your electronic invoices
hero.description: An intelligent platform to extract, validate, sign and track your invoices through their submission to TTN.

trust.title: A platform designed for Tunisian and French companies

features.label: Features
features.title: The complete invoicing lifecycle in one platform
features.description: A centralized solution designed to reduce manual tasks and improve traceability.

extraction.title: Intelligent extraction
extraction.description: Import a PDF or scanned invoice. The platform automatically extracts suppliers, customers, invoice lines, taxes and totals.

erp.title: ERP connection
erp.description: Import invoices directly from your ERP without manually entering the data again.

validation.title: Automatic validation
validation.description: Verify required fields, amounts, taxes and data inconsistencies.

signature.title: Electronic signature
signature.description: Sign invoices using a secure XAdES electronic signature.

ttn.title: TTN submission
ttn.description: Submit signed invoices to TTN and retrieve their processing status.

tracking.title: Status tracking
tracking.description: View accepted, rejected, pending invoices and invoices requiring resubmission.

workflow.label: How it works
workflow.title: From invoice import to TTN submission in a few steps
workflow.description: A simple, centralized and fully traceable process.

import.title: Import
import.description: Upload a PDF, a scanned invoice or select an invoice from your ERP.

extract.title: Extract
extract.description: The platform automatically converts invoice information into structured data.

verify.title: Verify
verify.description: Required fields, amounts, taxes and invoice lines are checked.

sign.title: Sign
sign.description: The invoice is electronically signed using an XAdES signature.

send.title: Submit
send.description: The signed document is submitted to the TTN platform.

track.title: Track
track.description: Accepted, rejected or pending statuses are displayed in the dashboard.

solutions.label: Solutions
solutions.title: A solution adapted to every need
solutions.description: The platform supports small organizations as well as companies already using an ERP.

benefits.label: Benefits
benefits.title: Why choose our platform?
benefits.description: Increase productivity while maintaining complete invoice traceability.

speed.title: Faster processing
speed.description: Reduce the time spent entering and verifying invoice data.

security.title: Secure data
security.description: Protect access, user accounts and electronically signed documents.

tracking.title: Real-time tracking
tracking.description: View the status and history of every invoice at any time.

errors.title: Fewer errors
errors.description: Detect inconsistencies before invoice generation and submission.

security.label: Security
security.title: Security at the core of your invoicing process
security.description: Accounts, documents and operations are protected throughout every processing step.

cta.label: Get started now
cta.title: Ready to simplify your invoice management?
cta.description: Create your account and centralize your invoices, signatures and TTN status tracking.

footer.description: An intelligent platform to centralize, validate, sign and track electronic invoices.
